title: Capture of Tabriz (1585)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Tabriz (1585)", at revision 1370609678, opens: "The Capture of Tabriz by the Ottoman Empire in 1585 was a momentous event in the Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q119167853, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1585 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
